meta.title: Old Friend
meta.description: In a place where the lights are always on, it seems as though an old friend has come.

units.rawText: Several days later, outside the Burbank Sector firewall.
units.displayText: Several days later, outside the Burbank Sector firewall.

spans.text: Several days later, outside the Burbank Sector firewall.

units.rawText: We're here at last!
units.displayText: We're here at last!

spans.text: We're here at last!

units.rawText: So what do we do now, wait for someone from the Burbank Sector to come out and welcome us?
units.displayText: So what do we do now, wait for someone from the Burbank Sector to come out and welcome us?

spans.text: So what do we do now, wait for someone from the Burbank Sector to come out and welcome us?

units.rawText: Nonono, you're way too old-fashioned, Professor.
units.displayText: Nonono, you're way too old-fashioned, Professor.

spans.text: Nonono, you're way too old-fashioned, Professor.

units.rawText: Behold – Open sesame!
units.displayText: Behold – Open sesame!

spans.text: Behold – Open sesame!

units.rawText: Kuro takes out something and waves it in front of the sector firewall.
units.displayText: Kuro takes out something and waves it in front of the sector firewall.

spans.text: Kuro takes out something and waves it in front of the sector firewall.

units.rawText: Unknown visitor detected. Now performing identity verification.
units.displayText: Unknown visitor detected. Now performing identity verification.

spans.text: Unknown visitor detected. Now performing identity verification.

units.rawText: What's this?
units.displayText: What's this?

spans.text: What's this?

units.rawText: It's the electronic bracelet that came with the invitation. This is proprietary tech for the Burbank Sector. All we need to do is swipe it and it automatically verifies your identity and logs you in.
units.displayText: It's the electronic bracelet that came with the invitation. This is proprietary tech for the Burbank Sector. All we need to do is swipe it and it automatically verifies your identity and logs you in.

spans.text: It's the electronic bracelet that came with the invitation. This is proprietary tech for the Burbank Sector. All we need to do is swipe it and it automatically verifies your identity and logs you in.

units.rawText: Hehe, that's Nanaka for you, she saved me the trouble of explaining all that. How do you like it?
units.displayText: Hehe, that's Nanaka for you, she saved me the trouble of explaining all that. How do you like it?

spans.text: Hehe, that's Nanaka for you, she saved me the trouble of explaining all that. How do you like it?
It sounds pretty neat.

options.rawText: Don't they use those at swimming pools...
options.displayText: Don't they use those at swimming pools...

spans.text: Don't they use those at swimming pools...

options.rawText: Then wouldn't it be very dangerous if it got hacked?
options.displayText: Then wouldn't it be very dangerous if it got hacked?

spans.text: Then wouldn't it be very dangerous if it got hacked?

units.rawText: Tch, what a half-hearted reply. You're not messing with me, are you, Professor?
units.displayText: Tch, what a half-hearted reply. You're not messing with me, are you, Professor?

spans.text: Tch, what a half-hearted reply. You're not messing with me, are you, Professor?

units.rawText: Hell no! The technology isn't the thing, it's all about the user experience, u-ser-ex-pe-ri-ence!
units.displayText: Hell no! The technology isn't the thing, it's all about the user experience, u-ser-ex-pe-ri-ence!

spans.text: Hell no! The technology isn't the thing, it's all about the user experience, u-ser-ex-pe-ri-ence!

units.rawText: The secret of Cyber Media's success is always being focused on giving everyone new and fresh experiences!
units.displayText: The secret of Cyber Media's success is always being focused on giving everyone new and fresh experiences!

spans.text: The secret of Cyber Media's success is always being focused on giving everyone new and fresh experiences!

units.rawText: How could they be hacked so easily? Not everyone is like Anna, you know.
units.displayText: How could they be hacked so easily? Not everyone is like Anna, you know.

spans.text: How could they be hacked so easily? Not everyone is like Anna, you know.

units.rawText: [Authentication successful. Welcome to the Burbank Sector.]
units.displayText: [Authentication successful. Welcome to the Burbank Sector.]

spans.text: [Authentication successful. Welcome to the Burbank Sector.]

units.rawText: Ah, the authentication went through. Everyone, let's head on in first!
units.displayText: Ah, the authentication went through. Everyone, let's head on in first!

spans.text: Ah, the authentication went through. Everyone, let's head on in first!

units.rawText: So this is the "big city" Riko was talking about...
units.displayText: So this is the "big city" Riko was talking about...

spans.text: So this is the "big city" Riko was talking about...

units.rawText: It's past Magrasea's midnight by the time we arrive, but this city is still brightly lit.
units.displayText: It's past Magrasea's midnight by the time we arrive, but this city is still brightly lit.

spans.text: It's past Magrasea's midnight by the time we arrive, but this city is still brightly lit.

units.rawText: The dazzling neon lights, the clamor of people's voices, the holographic performances that can be seen anywhere, all of them constantly stimulate our senses...
units.displayText: The dazzling neon lights, the clamor of people's voices, the holographic performances that can be seen anywhere, all of them constantly stimulate our senses...

spans.text: The dazzling neon lights, the clamor of people's voices, the holographic performances that can be seen anywhere, all of them constantly stimulate our senses...

units.rawText: And number one on this week's top songs – Re:Birthday!
units.displayText: And number one on this week's top songs – Re:Birthday!

spans.text: And number one on this week's top songs – Re:Birthday!

units.rawText: Bros in the channel, Mysterious Warrior is having a special performance at 8 tonight! I'll be waiting for you on the festival stage!
units.displayText: Bros in the channel, Mysterious Warrior is having a special performance at 8 tonight! I'll be waiting for you on the festival stage!

spans.text: Bros in the channel, Mysterious Warrior is having a special performance at 8 tonight! I'll be waiting for you on the festival stage!

units.rawText: [Great deals for you at the Puppy Disco! We're now offering transformation services! Free your true self and come dance the night away!]
units.displayText: [Great deals for you at the Puppy Disco! We're now offering transformation services! Free your true self and come dance the night away!]

spans.text: [Great deals for you at the Puppy Disco! We're now offering transformation services! Free your true self and come dance the night away!]

units.rawText: It really is something else. An entertainment hub of this size would be hard to find even in the real world.
units.displayText: It really is something else. An entertainment hub of this size would be hard to find even in the real world.

spans.text: It really is something else. An entertainment hub of this size would be hard to find even in the real world.

units.rawText: This place is just too cool. Ah! They even have open-air theaters here!
units.displayText: This place is just too cool. Ah! They even have open-air theaters here!

spans.text: This place is just too cool. Ah! They even have open-air theaters here!

units.rawText: Is that huge thing over there the main stage? Who's that in black over there, anyway?
units.displayText: Is that huge thing over there the main stage? Who's that in black over there, anyway?

spans.text: Is that huge thing over there the main stage? Who's that in black over there, anyway?

units.rawText: Hehehe, the way you guys are making a fuss about everything makes you all look like country bumpkins.
units.displayText: Hehehe, the way you guys are making a fuss about everything makes you all look like country bumpkins.

spans.text: Hehehe, the way you guys are making a fuss about everything makes you all look like country bumpkins.

units.rawText: Wow, there's a multicolored kitty by the side of the road!
units.displayText: Wow, there's a multicolored kitty by the side of the road!

spans.text: Wow, there's a multicolored kitty by the side of the road!

units.rawText: That's Nanaka for you, you've got a gift for spotting beauty.
units.displayText: That's Nanaka for you, you've got a gift for spotting beauty.

spans.text: That's Nanaka for you, you've got a gift for spotting beauty.

units.rawText: Hey! No fair with the double standards!
units.displayText: Hey! No fair with the double standards!

spans.text: Hey! No fair with the double standards!

units.rawText: Ahem. These are not double standards, I'm simply shifting the benchmarks according to the person in question...
units.displayText: Ahem. These are not double standards, I'm simply shifting the benchmarks according to the person in question...

spans.text: Ahem. These are not double standards, I'm simply shifting the benchmarks according to the person in question...

units.rawText: Wow, look at that statue over there!
units.displayText: Wow, look at that statue over there!

spans.text: Wow, look at that statue over there!

units.rawText: Are you even listening to me?!
units.displayText: Are you even listening to me?!

spans.text: Are you even listening to me?!

units.rawText: Ew, it looks kind of creepy when you look at it close up...
units.displayText: Ew, it looks kind of creepy when you look at it close up...

spans.text: Ew, it looks kind of creepy when you look at it close up...

units.rawText: Sol's attention is drawn to several strangely-shaped statues amidst the carnival parade. They're painted in dazzlingly-bright colors and have excessively showy poses. When combined with the incredibly realistic way they've been carved, it looks as though they might come to life at any moment.
units.displayText: Sol's attention is drawn to several strangely-shaped statues amidst the carnival parade. They're painted in dazzlingly-bright colors and have excessively showy poses. When combined with the incredibly realistic way they've been carved, it looks as though they might come to life at any moment.

spans.text: Sol's attention is drawn to several strangely-shaped statues amidst the carnival parade. They're painted in dazzlingly-bright colors and have excessively showy poses. When combined with the incredibly realistic way they've been carved, it looks as though they might come to life at any moment.

units.rawText: What's so creepy about them? Have you never been to an art museum before?
units.displayText: What's so creepy about them? Have you never been to an art museum before?

spans.text: What's so creepy about them? Have you never been to an art museum before?

units.rawText: I don't know anything about them, but any way you slice it, these guys don't look like they belong in a festival, right?
units.displayText: I don't know anything about them, but any way you slice it, these guys don't look like they belong in a festival, right?

spans.text: I don't know anything about them, but any way you slice it, these guys don't look like they belong in a festival, right?

units.rawText: The cutting edge of art and festivals go hand in hand, of course! Even if your neural cloud can't appreciate this sort of thing, surely you don't need to tremble in fear, right?
units.displayText: The cutting edge of art and festivals go hand in hand, of course! Even if your neural cloud can't appreciate this sort of thing, surely you don't need to tremble in fear, right?

spans.text: The cutting edge of art and festivals go hand in hand, of course! Even if your neural cloud can't appreciate this sort of thing, surely you don't need to tremble in fear, right?

units.rawText: I'm not trembling... I just found them suspicious and I went on the defensive on reflex.
units.displayText: I'm not trembling... I just found them suspicious and I went on the defensive on reflex.

spans.text: I'm not trembling... I just found them suspicious and I went on the defensive on reflex.

units.rawText: Oh? You're not scared, are you?
units.displayText: Oh? You're not scared, are you?

spans.text: Oh? You're not scared, are you?

units.rawText: See, poke.
units.displayText: See, poke.

spans.text: See, poke.

units.rawText: Hey! You actually touched it!
units.displayText: Hey! You actually touched it!

spans.text: Hey! You actually touched it!

units.rawText: I mean, it's not like there's a sign saying "Please do not touch" around, right? What's so–
units.displayText: I mean, it's not like there's a sign saying "Please do not touch" around, right? What's so–

spans.text: I mean, it's not like there's a sign saying "Please do not touch" around, right? What's so–

units.rawText: Urrrrrk?!
units.displayText: Urrrrrk?!

spans.text: Urrrrrk?!

units.rawText: The slumbering statue lights up and suddenly lurches into motion, knocking Kuro to the ground in an instant.
units.displayText: The slumbering statue lights up and suddenly lurches into motion, knocking Kuro to the ground in an instant.

spans.text: The slumbering statue lights up and suddenly lurches into motion, knocking Kuro to the ground in an instant.

units.rawText: Kuro!
units.displayText: Kuro!

spans.text: Kuro!

units.rawText: Crap!
units.displayText: Crap!

spans.text: Crap!

units.rawText: Sharp claws swipe at Kuro, who is lying on the ground. Sol draws her sword and blocks the attack, but she loses several strands of hair in the process.
units.displayText: Sharp claws swipe at Kuro, who is lying on the ground. Sol draws her sword and blocks the attack, but she loses several strands of hair in the process.

spans.text: Sharp claws swipe at Kuro, who is lying on the ground. Sol draws her sword and blocks the attack, but she loses several strands of hair in the process.

units.rawText: What, what's going on?!
units.displayText: What, what's going on?!

spans.text: What, what's going on?!

units.rawText: This guy is strong!
units.displayText: This guy is strong!

spans.text: This guy is strong!

units.rawText: Sol's strength gradually loses out to the massive statue. Just as it's about to hit her head–
units.displayText: Sol's strength gradually loses out to the massive statue. Just as it's about to hit her head–

spans.text: Sol's strength gradually loses out to the massive statue. Just as it's about to hit her head–

units.rawText: Cease.
units.displayText: Cease.

spans.text: Cease.

units.rawText: Someone suddenly appears behind the statue, and with a wave of a hand, it freezes the statue in place.
units.displayText: Someone suddenly appears behind the statue, and with a wave of a hand, it freezes the statue in place.

spans.text: Someone suddenly appears behind the statue, and with a wave of a hand, it freezes the statue in place.

units.rawText: Clack–
units.displayText: Clack–

spans.text: Clack–

units.rawText: Sol!
units.displayText: Sol!

spans.text: Sol!

units.rawText: Ugh... I'm fine, but this person...
units.displayText: Ugh... I'm fine, but this person...

spans.text: Ugh... I'm fine, but this person...

units.rawText: The strength leaves Sol for a moment, and she has to lean on her sword for support as she looks up at the smiling, silver-haired girl before her.
units.displayText: The strength leaves Sol for a moment, and she has to lean on her sword for support as she looks up at the smiling, silver-haired girl before her.

spans.text: The strength leaves Sol for a moment, and she has to lean on her sword for support as she looks up at the smiling, silver-haired girl before her.

units.rawText: I apologize for the fright, esteemed guests.
units.displayText: I apologize for the fright, esteemed guests.

spans.text: I apologize for the fright, esteemed guests.

units.rawText: You are...?
units.displayText: You are...?

spans.text: You are...?

units.rawText: Ah, I forgot to introduce myself. I am Eos, the tour guide agent for this Burbank Sector festival.
units.displayText: Ah, I forgot to introduce myself. I am Eos, the tour guide agent for this Burbank Sector festival.

spans.text: Ah, I forgot to introduce myself. I am Eos, the tour guide agent for this Burbank Sector festival.

units.rawText: Are you <cmdr> of the Oasis? I can sense the tour guide card you brought with you.
units.displayText: Are you {교수} of the Oasis? I can sense the tour guide card you brought with you.

spans.text: Are you
of the Oasis? I can sense the tour guide card you brought with you.

units.rawText: I subconsciously back up a step as I look at the smiling Eos.
units.displayText: I subconsciously back up a step as I look at the smiling Eos.

spans.text: I subconsciously back up a step as I look at the smiling Eos.

units.rawText: What's the matter, Professor?
units.displayText: What's the matter, Professor?

spans.text: What's the matter, Professor?

options.rawText: Don't you think she looks very familiar?
options.displayText: Don't you think she looks very familiar?

spans.text: Don't you think she looks very familiar?

options.rawText: Don't you find this all very strange?
options.displayText: Don't you find this all very strange?

spans.text: Don't you find this all very strange?

units.rawText: Familiar? Are you friends with someone as pretty as this?
units.displayText: Familiar? Are you friends with someone as pretty as this?

spans.text: Familiar? Are you friends with someone as pretty as this?

units.rawText: Are you talking about similar appearances? Many agents are mass-produced, so it's true that many of them would end up looking alike.
units.displayText: Are you talking about similar appearances? Many agents are mass-produced, so it's true that many of them would end up looking alike.

spans.text: Are you talking about similar appearances? Many agents are mass-produced, so it's true that many of them would end up looking alike.

units.rawText: But her Signature states that she's from the Burbank Sector. By "familiar", are you talking about...
units.displayText: But her Signature states that she's from the Burbank Sector. By "familiar", are you talking about...

spans.text: But her Signature states that she's from the Burbank Sector. By "familiar", are you talking about...

units.rawText: Strange? How is this strange, Professor?
units.displayText: Strange? How is this strange, Professor?

spans.text: Strange? How is this strange, Professor?

units.rawText: I mean, the appearance of this tour guide...
units.displayText: I mean, the appearance of this tour guide...

spans.text: I mean, the appearance of this tour guide...

units.rawText: Many agents are mass-produced, so having the same face is a common occurrence on the cloud server.
units.displayText: Many agents are mass-produced, so having the same face is a common occurrence on the cloud server.

spans.text: Many agents are mass-produced, so having the same face is a common occurrence on the cloud server.

units.rawText: But going by her Signature, I've never met her before. Did you notice something, Professor?
units.displayText: But going by her Signature, I've never met her before. Did you notice something, Professor?

spans.text: But going by her Signature, I've never met her before. Did you notice something, Professor?

units.rawText: Her Signature, hm... Well, that's true. Agents identify themselves through their Signatures.
units.displayText: Her Signature, hm... Well, that's true. Agents identify themselves through their Signatures.

spans.text: Her Signature, hm... Well, that's true. Agents identify themselves through their Signatures.

units.rawText: While I wasn't particularly familiar with any of them, I understand them, more or less... Ah, were you expecting me to further verify her Signature, Professor?
units.displayText: While I wasn't particularly familiar with any of them, I understand them, more or less... Ah, were you expecting me to further verify her Signature, Professor?

spans.text: While I wasn't particularly familiar with any of them, I understand them, more or less... Ah, were you expecting me to further verify her Signature, Professor?

units.rawText: Do you mind, Miss Eos?
units.displayText: Do you mind, Miss Eos?

spans.text: Do you mind, Miss Eos?

units.rawText: Of course not. By all means.
units.displayText: Of course not. By all means.

spans.text: Of course not. By all means.

units.rawText: Eos sweeps her hair back and exposes the sleek nape of her neck.
units.displayText: Eos sweeps her hair back and exposes the sleek nape of her neck.

spans.text: Eos sweeps her hair back and exposes the sleek nape of her neck.

units.rawText: Hm... Yup, it's all there. Don't worry, Professor. She's a bona fide tour guide!
units.displayText: Hm... Yup, it's all there. Don't worry, Professor. She's a bona fide tour guide!

spans.text: Hm... Yup, it's all there. Don't worry, Professor. She's a bona fide tour guide!

units.rawText: Still, don't you think her looks and style of dress look kind of like a certain someone...
units.displayText: Still, don't you think her looks and style of dress look kind of like a certain someone...

spans.text: Still, don't you think her looks and style of dress look kind of like a certain someone...

units.rawText: Well, I suppose she DOES look a little familiar.
units.displayText: Well, I suppose she DOES look a little familiar.

spans.text: Well, I suppose she DOES look a little familiar.

units.rawText: But her Signature say that she's an ordinary agent.
units.displayText: But her Signature say that she's an ordinary agent.

spans.text: But her Signature say that she's an ordinary agent.

units.rawText: Can you fake Signatures?
units.displayText: Can you fake Signatures?

spans.text: Can you fake Signatures?

units.rawText: I've analyzed her Signature. It shows no signs of being edited.
units.displayText: I've analyzed her Signature. It shows no signs of being edited.

spans.text: I've analyzed her Signature. It shows no signs of being edited.

units.rawText: Not even an administrator can clear Signature edit logs that easily. Therefore... she should be safe.
units.displayText: Not even an administrator can clear Signature edit logs that easily. Therefore... she should be safe.

spans.text: Not even an administrator can clear Signature edit logs that easily. Therefore... she should be safe.

units.rawText: (But if it were that person... then they would have higher access than an administrator.)
units.displayText: But if it were that person... then they would have higher access than an administrator.

spans.text: But if it were that person... then they would have higher access than an administrator.

units.rawText: I apologize for startling you, but these statues are not dangerous. Rather, they are the guards for this festival.
units.displayText: I apologize for startling you, but these statues are not dangerous. Rather, they are the guards for this festival.

spans.text: I apologize for startling you, but these statues are not dangerous. Rather, they are the guards for this festival.

units.rawText: They simply detected a potential destructive act and made to apprehend the perpetrator.
units.displayText: They simply detected a potential destructive act and made to apprehend the perpetrator.

spans.text: They simply detected a potential destructive act and made to apprehend the perpetrator.

units.rawText: Seriously? That's a pretty unreasonable guard, don't you think?
units.displayText: Seriously? That's a pretty unreasonable guard, don't you think?

spans.text: Seriously? That's a pretty unreasonable guard, don't you think?

units.rawText: Kuro tries to step up in a menacing way to demand an answer, but after seeing the huge statue behind Eos, she silently returns to Nanaka's side.
units.displayText: Kuro tries to step up in a menacing way to demand an answer, but after seeing the huge statue behind Eos, she silently returns to Nanaka's side.

spans.text: Kuro tries to step up in a menacing way to demand an answer, but after seeing the huge statue behind Eos, she silently returns to Nanaka's side.

units.rawText: And it looks so scary too, the person who made it must have been a weirdo... I want compensation for psychological damage!
units.displayText: And it looks so scary too, the person who made it must have been a weirdo... I want compensation for psychological damage!

spans.text: And it looks so scary too, the person who made it must have been a weirdo... I want compensation for psychological damage!

units.rawText: It was a failing on our part for subjecting our esteemed guests to such a fright. We sincerely apologize.
units.displayText: It was a failing on our part for subjecting our esteemed guests to such a fright. We sincerely apologize.

spans.text: It was a failing on our part for subjecting our esteemed guests to such a fright. We sincerely apologize.

units.rawText: I am sure it would not have caused any trouble if it could tell that you were our honored guest, Miss Kuro.
units.displayText: I am sure it would not have caused any trouble if it could tell that you were our honored guest, Miss Kuro.

spans.text: I am sure it would not have caused any trouble if it could tell that you were our honored guest, Miss Kuro.

units.rawText: Hm? You know about me too?
units.displayText: Hm? You know about me too?

spans.text: Hm? You know about me too?

units.rawText: You are a great benefactor of ours, Miss Kuro. How could we possibly forget?
units.displayText: You are a great benefactor of ours, Miss Kuro. How could we possibly forget?

spans.text: You are a great benefactor of ours, Miss Kuro. How could we possibly forget?

units.rawText: We will circulate your data to all our guard statues and instruct them to treat you with the greatest respect.
units.displayText: We will circulate your data to all our guard statues and instruct them to treat you with the greatest respect.

spans.text: We will circulate your data to all our guard statues and instruct them to treat you with the greatest respect.

units.rawText: That's more like it! At least you know how to do your job.
units.displayText: That's more like it! At least you know how to do your job.

spans.text: That's more like it! At least you know how to do your job.

units.rawText: Is the handling of the situation to your liking, <cmdr>... Or should I say, "Professor"?
units.displayText: Is the handling of the situation to your liking, {교수}... Or should I say, "Professor"?

spans.text: Is the handling of the situation to your liking,
... Or should I say, "Professor"?
What's your aim?

options.rawText: Do you have more friends with you?
options.displayText: Do you have more friends with you?

spans.text: Do you have more friends with you?
Maybe I was mistaken.

units.rawText: So, you're still wary of me?
units.displayText: So, you're still wary of me?

spans.text: So, you're still wary of me?

units.rawText: I am simply an ordinary tour guide agent. My job is to show you and your friends around this festival.
units.displayText: I am simply an ordinary tour guide agent. My job is to show you and your friends around this festival.

spans.text: I am simply an ordinary tour guide agent. My job is to show you and your friends around this festival.

units.rawText: The work of being your tour guide was assigned to myself alone. After all, everyone else is preparing for the festival.
units.displayText: The work of being your tour guide was assigned to myself alone. After all, everyone else is preparing for the festival.

spans.text: The work of being your tour guide was assigned to myself alone. After all, everyone else is preparing for the festival.

units.rawText: If you don't believe me, you can look around – there's nobody else here who's dressed like me, right?
units.displayText: If you don't believe me, you can look around – there's nobody else here who's dressed like me, right?

spans.text: If you don't believe me, you can look around – there's nobody else here who's dressed like me, right?

units.rawText: Thank you for your understanding.
units.displayText: Thank you for your understanding.

spans.text: Thank you for your understanding.

units.rawText: Still, you're dressed quite plainly. I thought the Burbank Sector agents would be more liberal.
units.displayText: Still, you're dressed quite plainly. I thought the Burbank Sector agents would be more liberal.

spans.text: Still, you're dressed quite plainly. I thought the Burbank Sector agents would be more liberal.

units.rawText: Just based off your outfit, I wouldn't be surprised if you were a Sanctifier.
units.displayText: Just based off your outfit, I wouldn't be surprised if you were a Sanctifier.

spans.text: Just based off your outfit, I wouldn't be surprised if you were a Sanctifier.

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: There are many fashion trends in the Burbank Sector. If you so wish I can serve you with a different look in the future.
units.displayText: There are many fashion trends in the Burbank Sector. If you so wish I can serve you with a different look in the future.

spans.text: There are many fashion trends in the Burbank Sector. If you so wish I can serve you with a different look in the future.

units.rawText: However, could you allow me to retain this appearance for the duration of the festival?
units.displayText: However, could you allow me to retain this appearance for the duration of the festival?

spans.text: However, could you allow me to retain this appearance for the duration of the festival?

units.rawText: Eos looks at me with a tender expression on her face.
units.displayText: Eos looks at me with a tender expression on her face.

spans.text: Eos looks at me with a tender expression on her face.

units.rawText: I carefully study my surroundings, but I don't see signs of other Sanctifiers. Could it be that "she" is just here to feel us out...
units.displayText: I carefully study my surroundings, but I don't see signs of other Sanctifiers. Could it be that "she" is just here to feel us out...

spans.text: I carefully study my surroundings, but I don't see signs of other Sanctifiers. Could it be that "she" is just here to feel us out...

units.rawText: (In any case, this is a good chance for the Oasis. Besides, there's no telling how much havoc it would cause if we were to force "her" to reveal her true form...)

units.rawText: First of all, please allow me to distribute these festival bracelets to everyone. All expenditures and tipping will be conducted through these bracelets in order to facilitate billing.

units.rawText: The moon has not fully risen yet, so we can visit the shops on the periphery at leisure. Please do not be alarmed if you run into a surprise show or event during the process. Rather, feel free to participate.

units.rawText: This is pretty good! It's nice and lively, kind of relaxing, in a way.

units.rawText: After that, there will be a performance at the Crescente Theater. If Miss Kuro and Miss Nanaka wish, I can announce the two of you and arrange for you to squeeze an item into the lineup.

units.rawText: Eh... Does that mean we can perform on stage too?

spans.text: Eh... Does that mean we can perform on stage too?

units.rawText: The two of you are great contributors to the Burbank Sector. There will always be a place on stage reserved for you.

spans.text: Woohoo! Then what are you waiting for, hurry up and do it already!

units.rawText: I'll notify them right away. After the performance at the "Crescente" Theater, you can prepare for the big rave at the "Luna Piena" Theater. That will be the biggest event for this festival...

units.displayText: Sol suddenly locks onto someone in the distance.

spans.text: Sol suddenly locks onto someone in the distance.

units.rawText: What is it now, Sol?
units.displayText: What is it now, Sol?

spans.text: What is it now, Sol?

units.rawText: Those fox ears... Isn't that Riko?
units.displayText: Those fox ears... Isn't that Riko?

spans.text: Those fox ears... Isn't that Riko?

units.rawText: I haven't seen her in a while, turns out she was wandering around out here!

spans.text: I haven't seen her in a while, turns out she was wandering around out here!

units.rawText: We turn toward the direction where Sol is looking. Though we can't see her head, we can definitely see a pair of foxy ears poking out above the crowd.
units.displayText: We turn toward the direction where Sol is looking. Though we can't see her head, we can definitely see a pair of foxy ears poking out above the crowd.

spans.text: We turn toward the direction where Sol is looking. Though we can't see her head, we can definitely see a pair of foxy ears poking out above the crowd.

units.rawText: Heeeeey– Riko!
units.displayText: Heeeeey– Riko!

spans.text: Heeeeey– Riko!

units.displayText: Sol shouts and the ears tremble, then they suddenly duck down and vanish out of sight.

spans.text: Sol shouts and the ears tremble, then they suddenly duck down and vanish out of sight.

units.displayText: Huh? It's only been a while and she's pretending we're strangers already?

units.rawText: Professor, this...
units.displayText: Professor, this...

spans.text: Professor, this...

units.displayText: You should go too, Persicaria.

spans.text: You should go too, Persicaria.

units.rawText: Once you find Riko, ask her about news that will help us in working with this Sector's administrator.

units.displayText: Understood, Miss Persicaria.

spans.text: Understood, Miss Persicaria.

units.rawText: We watch as Persicaria and Sol vanish into the distance, and then Eos suddenly smiles at me.

spans.text: We watch as Persicaria and Sol vanish into the distance, and then Eos suddenly smiles at me.

units.rawText: Professor.
units.displayText: Professor.

spans.text: Professor.

units.rawText: Did you deliberately send them off so you could be alone with me?
units.displayText: Did you deliberately send them off so you could be alone with me?

spans.text: Did you deliberately send them off so you could be alone with me?

spans.text: Now that was straight to the point. Not intending to hide it any more?

units.rawText: Since you can tell, there's no point in trying to cover it up.

spans.text: Since you can tell, there's no point in trying to cover it up.

options.rawText: I'm glad to see you showing some kindness.
